description: This file defines a React-based custom node view class for ProseMirror editor, used within the Notesnook project. It manages rendering, updating, and drag-and-drop behavior of editor nodes with React components.

classes.name: ReactNodeView
classes.description: A React-based implementation of ProseMirror's NodeView, handling rendering, updates, and drag-and-drop for editor nodes.

methods.name: createNodeView
methods.description: Factory function to create a ReactNodeView instance for a given React component.

methods.name: forceHandleDrag
methods.description: Handles custom drag behavior for node views, serializing content for drag-and-drop.
